profile.summary: NWE Resources Group Berhad engages in the supply of health foods and personal care and related products. The company's supply of health foods business comprises two segments: distribution of health foods; and formulation and supply of health foods. It engages in the distribution of health foods through direct selling. Its health foods are distributed through its brands ReDiant, Diva, D'Joy Plus and K-Cha, and a third-party brand Miki. It also sells goat's milk tablets. Additionally, the company engages in developing health food formulations. The company's supply of personal care and related products business comprises two segments: repackaging and manufacturing of personal care products; and distribution of personal care products. Its personal care products include hospitality amenities supplied to short-stay accommodation establishments, including hotels and resorts, service apartments, homes, and villas. Its repackaged personal care products include skin care, hair care, and oral care products, and vanity kits; room linens and amenities, such as sheets, pillowcases, blankets, laundry bags, slippers, shoe mitts, shower caps, sanitary bags, and sewing kits; and liquid personal care products; such as shampoos, conditioners, body wash, liquid hand soaps, hand sanitisers, and lotions. In addition, the company's personal care products and related products are marketed under its own brands LuxZuki, Aloe Vera Premier Gel, DX Izumi, and Lemon Essence Dishwash. Additionally, the company also supplies repackaged F&B products, such as instant coffee, white and brown sugar, and powdered non-dairy creamer. The company operates in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Brunei, Hong Kong, the Maldives, and South Korea. NWE Resources Group Berhad was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia.
profile.zh: NWE Resources Group Berhad 成立于1979年，总部位于马来西亚莎阿南，从事健康食品及个人护理产品的供应业务，业务覆盖马来西亚、新加坡、印度尼西亚、文莱、香港、马尔代夫和韩国。
lines: 健康食品分销：通过直销渠道分销自有品牌 ReDiant、Diva、D'Joy Plus、K-Cha 及第三方品牌 Miki 的健康食品，并销售羊奶片。
健康食品配方与供应：开发健康食品配方并进行供应。
个人护理产品分装与制造：对护肤品、护发品、口腔护理产品、洗漱用品套装、客房布草及设施（如床单、枕套、拖鞋等）以及液体个人护理产品（如洗发水、沐浴露、洗手液等）进行分装和制造。
个人护理产品分销：向酒店、度假村、服务式公寓、住宅和别墅等短租住宿场所供应酒店客房用品，并以自有品牌 LuxZuki、Aloe Vera Premier Gel、DX Izumi 和 Lemon Essence Dishwash 进行营销。
食品饮料产品供应：供应分装的食品饮料产品，如速溶咖啡、白砂糖、黄糖和非乳制奶精。
lines_en: Health Food Distribution: Distributes health foods through direct selling under own brands ReDiant, Diva, D'Joy Plus, K-Cha and third-party brand Miki, and sells goat's milk tablets.
Health Food Formulation and Supply: Develops health food formulations and supplies health foods.

Personal Care Repackaging and Manufacturing: Repackages and manufactures personal care products including skin care, hair care, oral care, vanity kits, room linens and amenities (e.g., sheets, pillowcases, slippers), and liquid personal care products (e.g., shampoos, body wash, hand soaps).

Personal Care Distribution: Supplies hospitality amenities to hotels, resorts, service apartments, homes, and villas, and markets personal care products under own brands LuxZuki, Aloe Vera Premier Gel, DX Izumi, and Lemon Essence Dishwash.
F&B Product Supply: Supplies repackaged F&B products such as instant coffee, white and brown sugar, and powdered non-dairy creamer.
